definitions.transfer_gap: English accuracy minus target-language accuracy for the same model and split
definitions.tokenizer_fertility: Tokenizer tokens divided by non-whitespace Unicode characters, with no special tokens
definitions.normalized_fertility: Target-language fertility divided by English fertility on matched source_id questions
definitions.typological_distance: Cosine distance from English over concatenated URIEL/lang2vec syntax_knn and inventory_knn vectors
definitions.resource_quantity: Common Crawl page count from CC-MAIN-2026-21; plots use log10(page count)
